task_description.overview: Compute and visualize a continuous wavelet transform (CWT) scalogram of seismic waveform data using ObsPy’s internal routine based on Kristekova2006.
steps: Load seismic waveform data into an ObsPy Stream object.
Select the first Trace from the Stream and extract data, number of points, and sampling interval.
Define CWT parameters: voices per octave, minimum frequency (f_min), and maximum frequency (f_max).
Call obspy.signal.tf_misfit.cwt() with the trace data, sampling interval, voices per octave, f_min, and f_max to compute the scalogram.
Create a time vector and frequency vector (log-spaced between f_min and f_max).
Plot the absolute value of the scalogram as a pcolormesh with a logarithmic frequency axis.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the seismic waveform from {seismic_waveform_path}. Compute the continuous wavelet transform using ObsPy's cwt routine with voices_per_octave={voices_per_octave}, f_min={f_min} Hz, and f_max={f_max} Hz. Output the scalogram matrix and generate a time-frequency plot with a logarithmic frequency axis. 
 Note: 1) Save the scalogram plot to {result_plot} and the scalogram data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
